coverage: Starter coverage: 127 source-reviewed addresses across 13 business types, including eight medical offices, eight med spas, three standalone restaurants, three independent lodging prospects and eight professional offices added September 22. Territory includes Fort Mill, Rock Hill, Tega Cay, Indian Land, Lake Wylie (Clover mailing address), Belmont, Gastonia, Charlotte, Waxhaw and Weddington. This is not a complete territory list. Addresses were reviewed against official organization websites; explicit PO boxes are retained for mailing. Prospect notes identify known appointment, suite and access considerations. Postal deliverability, property ownership, exterior approval authority, surface condition and coating suitability have not been verified.
